text:
maya: Quick status check — where are we on Optimize toolkit delivery? Need a confirmed owner for quant recs + batching/caching recommendations and any regression alerts in the last 24h. cc @sam @devon

sam: I can own quant recs for now. Running profile jobs on model-x/model-y. Will post a short perf matrix to the PR by EOD.

devon: I'll own batching/caching defaults. Want to align on default batch sizes and cache TTLs. Noticed one flaky CI failing in embed tests.

maya: Thanks. Can you both add a small table: model -> quant config -> perf delta? That helps the rollout notes.

leo: FYI monitoring flagged a 95p latency bump on staging after the last quant PR — ~10-15ms uplift for short sequences.

infra-bot: [system] deploy 2024-03-05T17:12Z — staging canary: model-x @ 10% -> 50%

sam: Ok, running ablations now. Quick harness I used: ```python
# perf harness snippet
run_profile('model-x', batches=[1,4,8], seq_len=[32,128])
```

sue: Left a CR comment on the quant PR about layernorm dtype coercion. Might explain small regressions on edge cases.

devon: Got the CR, will add a dtype guard and a unit test.

tanaka: Request: freeze the canary until we confirm no regressions in staging. Also need a rollback plan in case perf degrades in prod.

maya: Agreed — freeze canary. @ci-bot please hold merges to the canary tag until we clear perf checks :eyes: 

ci-bot: [action] holds enabled on ref: canary/optimize-toolkit by maya

sam: Status update: perf runs 1/6 complete, initial delta for model-x q8 -> q4 is +12ms p95 for seq=32. I will add full matrix by 11:30 PT.

devon: Preparing config diff for cache/batching: ```yaml
batch_policy:
  default: [1,4]
  throughput: [8]
cache_policy:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_seconds: 600
```

leo: Added a temporary alert to paging rules: if p95 increases >8ms for 1h post-deploy, page infra oncall :bell:

sam: Running a targeted run with quant tweaks + no-layernorm-coerce. 2/6 done.

sue: Quick note — unit test added for the dtype path, pushed to the CR branch.

maya: Owners summary: sam (quant recs), devon (batch/cache), sue (CRs/QA), leo (infra monitoring), tanaka (rollback plan). I'll compile notes and post an async update later today. :+1:

leo: I'll keep the canary frozen and monitor; will post alerts if anything spikes.

sam: Will attach perf matrix and the small writeup to the PR when runs finish.

maya: Thanks team — please ping here if you see regressions or need to unfreeze.
